facts.street_query_semantics: specific point returns crimes within one mile; published locations are approximate/anonymised
facts.crime_category_contract: valid categories are date-specific and expose url/name fields
facts.response_identity_contract: persistent_id is the 64-character crime identifier; API id is not guaranteed stable and is not a police identifier
facts.outcome_contract: outcome_status may be absent; outcome history must not be inferred
facts.no_location_contract: some crimes cannot be mapped to a published location and are returned by a separate method
facts.api_rate_control: leaky bucket; 15 requests/second average, burst 30; HTTP 429 when exceeded
facts.raw_count_severity_contract: all-crime response length is an event count, not an ONS Crime Severity Score
facts.ons_css_contract: Crime Severity Score uses detailed offence types weighted using sentencing information
facts.ons_source_combination_contract: CSEW and police recorded crime have different strengths and limitations and are used together for a fuller picture

sources.name: ONS Crime Severity Score method and release watch

quality_limits: Point-based street queries cover one mile and return approximate/anonymised locations; they are not exact parcel or complete LSOA measurements.
May 2026 crime data is missing for four named forces and must not be inferred.
London LSOA data omits sexual offences and has CONNECT comparability limits.
Police open data is not assumed by its publisher to be complete or statistically official.
The API is rate-controlled; canonical runtime must retain one request per 16 unique endpoints and transient 429 handling.
outcome_status may be absent; API id is not a stable police identifier.
Location-based responses exclude crimes that could not be mapped to a published location.
Raw all-crime counts are not severity-weighted and must not be described as ONS Crime Severity Score.
The current repository manifest/report does not document the formula or official offence-weight table behind security_score_percent and weighted_crime_12m.
